profile.summary: La Europa Academy is a residential therapeutic school in Murray, Utah, for adolescents aged 14 to 17. Its program combines academics with therapy, including Dialectical Behavior Therapy (a skills-based talk therapy) and expressive therapies such as art, dance, music and writing. It serves students dealing with issues such as depression, anxiety, trauma and addictive behaviors.
